verdicts.reason: A and B are almost pixel-identical and share the same flaws. The original 'HOHOHO AGENCY' lockup is broken up: HOHOHO is now a small line below the tagline, so the reading order is reversed. An invisible white box behind the text cuts off the blue ring and the red zigzag lines with a hard vertical edge. The bottom shapes (trees, triangles, black circle) are clipped and squashed into a messy strip, and there is a large empty area at the top right. B sits a few pixels further right, which doesn't make it better or worse.
